title: MineShield Compass
description: Shows your coordinates only through the compass by adding a clean HUD above the hotbar, while removing all position data from the F3 debug screen. A simple, Mindshield-style way to make navigation more immersive.
body:
🧭 CompassHUD — Coordinates Only Through the Compass (Mindshield-style)

CompassHUD removes all position data from the F3 debug screen, making the compass the only way to see your coordinates — just like on Mindshield 4.

✨ Features
🧭 Compass Coordinate Display

Adds a clean HUD element above the hotbar showing your current position:
X: 122 Y: 64 Z: –172
(Updates in real time as you move.)

❌ No Coordinates in F3

The mod completely hides all coordinate information from the debug menu.
No more easy location tracking — navigation becomes more immersive and fair.

🎮 Minimal and Clean UI

No clutter, no distractions.
Only the coordinates you need, displayed in a compact and intuitive way.

📌 Perfect For:

Hardcore & survival servers

Roleplay worlds

Mindshield-style seasons

Players who want a realistic navigation experience
